news.title: New major risk - Market cap size
news.body: The company's market capitalization is less than US$10m. Market cap: ₹908.0m (US$9.59m) This is considered a major risk. Companies with a small market capitalization are most likely businesses that have not yet released a product to market or are simply a very small company without a wide reach. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. In addition, if the company's size is the main factor, it is less likely to have many investors and analysts following it and scrutinizing its performance and outlook. news.title: Newtime Infrastructure Limited Appoints Deepti Sharma as Chief Financial Officer, Effective January 9, 2026
news.body: Newtime Infrastructure Limited at its board meeting held on January 9, 2026, appointed Ms. Deepti Sharma as Chief Financial Officer of the Company with effect from January 9, 2026. Ms. Deepti Sharma is a dynamic and versatile professional with over 15 years of experience across finance & administration, relationship management. Proven ability to manage school operations, handle client relations, lead teams, and streamline organizational processes.
